answer.summary: Two deterministic ArchUnit failures introduced by this branch's new finding-retest code. FindingRetestService and FindingRetestSettlement access FindingRepository directly outside the allowed package, and FindingApi#retestFindings reads TenantContext.getCurrentTenant instead of the request TxCtx. Both rules failed on prior runs too (1x and 6x), so a rerun will fail the same way. Other failures in the log (the Crowdstrike JSON parse error) are logged noise and not the cause.
